clues: This city sits in a green valley in the south-west of Colombia. Two long chains of high mountains rise on each side of it.
Rain falls in this city all through the year, and even the driest month stays wet. Still, the dry season brings far less rain than the wet season.
On 31 March 1983, a strong quake shook this city and knocked down many of its fine old buildings. Much of its old glory was lost that day.
Its great church once held a famed crown set with green gems. Those gems had been taken from a beaten Inca king.
People call the old heart of this city the White City. Most of its old buildings are white, and grand old churches stand all round them.
